standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the dual E^vee, its finite local freeness, and exactness of tensoring by it.

core_obligations: Identify Hom_{O_X}(F, E tensor I) with Hom_{O_X}(F tensor E^vee, I) for the dual E^vee, noting that E^vee is finite locally free as well (proof lines 13827-13837).

Use that tensoring with a finite locally free sheaf is an exact functor, so the functor Hom(-, E tensor I) is exact, and conclude injectivity of E tensor I by the standard characterization of injective modules (proof lines 13837-13839).
proof_roadmap: Rewrite Homs into the tensor product using the dual module.
Use exactness of tensoring by a finite locally free sheaf.
Apply the characterization of injectives by exactness of the Hom functor.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the tensor product of an injective O_X-module I with a finite locally free O_X-module E is again injective. The proof uses the adjunction Hom(F, E tensor I) = Hom(F tensor E^vee, I) for the dual E^vee = SheafHom(E, O_X), which is again finite locally free, and then concludes by the standard criterion: since tensoring with a finite locally free sheaf is exact, the functor Hom(-, E tensor I) is exact and hence E tensor I is injective (proof lines 13827-13839). H2: the adjunction identification with the dual, combined with exactness of tensoring by a finite locally free sheaf, is the whole content, and neither step is a citation-only reduction.
